say:7:1220210004:0.text:
A... achoo!
What's that smell?! It's so pungent...
say:7:1220210004:0.source_cn: 啊、啊、啊啾！\n什么味道，好刺鼻……

say:8:1220210005:1.text: *Sob* I'm so sorry... I must smell awful.
say:8:1220210005:1.source_cn: 呜、呜呜，抱歉，我身上的味道很难闻吧？

say:9:1220210006:1.text: I tried so hard to clean up for my date, but no matter how much I bathe or wash my clothes, the smell just lingers.
say:9:1220210006:1.source_cn: 好不容易想约个会，我反复洗了好几次衣服和澡，但还是味道很重。

say:10:1220210007:1.text: Maybe it's because I wash my clothes in the same bathwater...
say:10:1220210007:1.source_cn: 可能是因为是用同一盆水洗，所以味道总是会留在身上吧……

say:11:1220210008:1.text: You wash your clothes in your old bathwater?!
say:11:1220210008:1.source_cn: 用同一盆水洗澡和洗衣服？！为什么要这么节省？！

say:12:1220210009:1.text: I have to prioritize fresh water for drinking, so it's rare to have enough water left over to wash both my body and my clothes...
say:12:1220210009:1.source_cn: 因为淡水都要先用于饮食，洗脸洗衣服的水非常难得，我节省...

say:13:1220210010:1.text: But isn't there a river nearby?
say:13:1220210010:1.source_cn: 但是，这附近不是有河流吗？

say:14:1220210011:1.text: Although river water is fresh, it has a strong salty smell because it flows into the sea.
say:14:1220210011:1.source_cn: 那条河虽然是淡水，但因为会入海，所以海腥味仍然很重。

say:15:1220210012:1.text: S-so, um... Mister esteemed mage, I'm terribly sorry to ask this but would you be willing to use some magic to remove my smell?
say:15:1220210012:1.source_cn: 所、所以，锈锚港的大英雄，尊敬的魔法师大人，能不能拜托...
say:15:1220210012:1.male: S-so, um... Mister esteemed mage, I'm terribly sorry to ask this but would you be willing to use some magic to remove my smell?
say:15:1220210012:1.female: S-so, um... Miss esteemed mage, I'm terribly sorry to ask this but would you be willing to use some magic to remove my smell?

say:16:1220210013:1.text: I haven't seen my beloved Fador in what feels like an eternity. I want to make sure I leave a beautiful impression, one he'll cherish.
say:16:1220210013:1.source_cn: 我和亲爱的法迪很久没有见面了，我想给他留个好印象……
